summary: Thin phone-news day (6/9 picks, ~67%, below the usual 70% target — widened the net on leaks/accessories rather than force weak filler) but Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 launch is the big story across every major outlet. Samsung's Galaxy AI going partly paid is the top phone angle, with iPhone 18/18e and Galaxy S27 buying-decision leaks rounding out the mix.

topics.working_title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
topics.why_now: Announced within the last ~18 hours; covered within hours by The Verge, TechCrunch, 9to5Mac and The Decoder, plus 900+ points on HN. Memeburn has nothing on it yet.
topics.angle: Cut through the launch-day noise: what's actually new in Fable 5.2 vs Mythos 5.2, the Artificial Analysis benchmark claim, and the $8/$40 per-million-token pricing — framed for readers deciding which model to use, not for ML researchers.
